Are you passionate about electronics, testing and automation, and eager to make a direct impact on the quality and manufacturability of high-tech products? Xelvin is looking for an experienced Production Test Engineer with a strong Electrical Engineering background to join the engineering team of a leading technology company in Eindhoven. In this role, you will develop and implement production test solutions for advanced electronic systems, ensuring products meet the highest quality standards before entering serial production. This employer designs and manufactures highly advanced electronic systems for demanding industries such as semiconductors, industrial, automotive, medical and defense. As a Production Test Engineer, you will play a key role in bridging product development and manufacturing by designing, developing and maintaining production test solutions. You will work closely with hardware, embedded software and manufacturing teams to ensure products can be efficiently and reliably tested throughout their lifecycle. Your responsibilities include: Developing production test strategies and test sequences for electronic products. Designing test hardware, including PCB-based test interfaces, fixtures and measurement circuits. Developing and maintaining automated test software using Python and C++. Performing Design for Testability (DfT) reviews during product development. Designing and maintaining automated production test setups. Supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) activities. Performing root cause analysis on production and test failures. Improving test coverage, production yield, reliability and manufacturing efficiency. Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the complete product lifecycle. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A competitive gross salary in the range of € 3.500 – €5.500 per month excluding 8% holiday allowance, depending on experience, technical expertise and results. Relocation package from Xelvin (see onboarding & benefits).

27 paid holidays in addition to public holidays, pension scheme and travel allowance. Holiday allowance of 8% of annual salary. A job with perspective. After the Xelvin contract you will be offered a direct contract with your employer. Career-oriented education, training and development opportunities. Excellent primary and secondary employment conditions. Onboarding & Benefits Your first house in the Netherlands will be arranged by Xelvin, with the help of our relocation team. Furthermore: A relocation assistance allowance will be paid to cover the cost of relocating to the Netherlands. You (and your family) will be picked up at the airport or train station and taken to your new home. Onboarding support: assistance with setting up a Dutch bank account, health insurance, BSN registration, dentist and GP registration and other practical matters. We organize several social gatherings throughout the year with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers. Functie-eisen To succeed in this role, you bring: Mandatory Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (Electronics / Electrical Engineering only). Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics. Experience designing electronic circuits and printed circuit boards. Must have: Proven experience with Altium Designer. Experience developing test solutions for electronic products. Experience working with laboratory and measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, DAQs and signal generators. Experience within electronics manufacturing, semiconductor, embedded systems or power electronics environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Fluent communication skills in English. Some experience with Python and/or C++ (basic). Preferred Experience with automated test systems and production environments. Experience with Design for Testability (DfT).  Posted on Sep 25, 2026 
TU Delft is looking for a talented postdoctoral researcher with expertise in quantum lattice Boltzmann methods or quantum lattice gas automata. 
Job description 
The QCFD Lab at TU Delft is at the forefront of developing quantum lattice Boltzmann methods in close collaboration with leading industry partners in quantum computation and from the aerospace sector. As we expand, we are looking for a motivated and talented postdoctoral researcher to strengthen our team. We expect candidates to have demonstrated expertise in the development of quantum lattice Boltzmann methods or quantum lattice gas automata and their theoretical analysis. You will develop and implement quantum circuits, evaluate them on quantum computing simulators and possibly hardware devices, and perform performance analyses and resource estimations. 
We believe in end-to-end solutions with practical advantage for real-world applications. If you decide to join the team, we expect you to fully dedicate to this mindset and contribute to advancing the state of the art of quantum CFD. 
Job requirements 
We expect you to hold a PhD degree (or be close to completing it) in applied mathematics or another computational science discipline and to have a proven track record in quantum lattice Boltzmann methods or quantum lattice gas automata, e.g., demonstrated through scientific publications or presentations. Experience with implementing quantum algorithms in Qiskit or other quantum programming frameworks is appreciated. 
We furthermore expect you to be fluent in English both in speaking and writing and able to communicate both in academic and industrial environment.
